passage:
Correlation — 相关性；关联
The team said, "Correlation is not causation.

causation — 因果关系；起因
The team said, "Correlation is not causation.

congestion — 拥堵；堵塞
They argued that fewer car lanes meant more congestion, so cars had to move more slowly.

efficient — 高效的；效率高的
This means the bus lane was two and a half times more efficient at moving people.

average — 平均的；平均数
They measured average travel time, bus passenger numbers, and the number of cars on the road.

increase — 增加；增长
Oak Street also saw a 50% increase in cars, and its travel time rose from 15 to 22 minutes.

concluded — 得出结论；断定
The team concluded that the bus lane was not the main cause of slower traffic.

measured — 测量；衡量
They measured average travel time, bus passenger numbers, and the number of cars on the road.
